item.title: He Had No Purpose… So We Made Him Try Every Job in 1 Day
item.description:
We're back helping sad dudes find their stoke, and today's sad dude is Logan, a 25-year-old who has applied to over 200 jobs, only has gotten three callbacks, and still has no idea what he's supposed to do with his life. We have 24 hours to help him find his purpose. To do it, we have him cut a stranger's hair at a bus stop, give legal advice at a dog park, perform a medical exam on Chad's stomach at Cedars-Sinai, and deliver a speech at City Council that had no business going that hard. Can we help Logan find his calling?!
Thank you magic mind for sponsoring this episode! https://magicmind.com/
